line_status.note: The fourth letter is printed as ח (closed top, matching the second-letter ח in the same word), not ה with a gap at the upper left; this also fits the gloss "union" (from יחד) and the reference 1 Chr. 8, 7, where the name is אֲחִיחֻד. Vowels and the qubbuts under ח are as in Reading A.
Under the mem the print shows a qamets (horizontal bar with a descending vertical stroke), not a pathach; everything else is identical in both readings and matches the page.

Second letter is ḥet (ח), not he (ה): the left leg joins the roof with no gap, consistent with the preceding line ("compounded from אָח and לַי") and the name Ahlai (1 Chr 2:31). Vowels pataḥ–shewa–pataḥ, final yod, no vav — both readings agree on these.
